# Happy Seeds

> Happy Seeds is the complete first vegetable garden in one box: ten curated varieties, 1,000+ lab-tested non-GMO seeds with the germination rate printed on every packet, a 24-page grow guide, and a slide-out keepsake box, for $24.99.

Happy Seeds (growhappyseeds.com) is an independent American seed kit brand. It sells one flagship product, the Veggie Garden Seed Kit ($24.99), and is launching a Herb Garden Seed Kit ($24.99). Contact: hello@growhappyseeds.com. Instagram @growhappyseeds.

## Veggie Garden Seed Kit facts
- Price: $24.99 ($2.50 per packet)
- Contents: 10 paper seed packets, 1,000+ seeds, 24-page grow guide, slide-out keepsake box with black foam insert and a fabric pull tab
- Seeds: non-GMO, open-pollinated, lab tested, germination rate printed on every packet
- Grows in containers, balcony planters, raised beds and backyard plots
- Where to buy: online through the Shop Now button at growhappyseeds.com, and at independent garden, gift and home stores
- Varieties:
- Tomato 'Floradade' (warm-season, 75 to 80 days from transplant)
- Carrot 'Danvers 126' (cool-season, 65 to 75 days)
- Cucumber 'Marketmore 76' (warm-season, 55 to 65 days)
- Kale 'Red Russian' (cool-season, 50 to 60 days)
- Spinach 'Bloomsdale' (cool-season, 40 to 50 days)
- Beet 'Chioggia' (cool-season, 50 to 60 days)
- Turnip 'Purple Top White Globe' (cool-season, 50 to 60 days)
- Eggplant 'Black Beauty' (warm-season, 75 to 85 days from transplant)
- Pepper 'Anaheim Chili' (warm-season, 75 to 80 days from transplant)
- Melon 'Honeydew Orange' (warm-season, 80 to 90 days)

## Herb Garden Seed Kit (coming soon)
Ten culinary herbs, $24.99: Sweet Basil 'Genovese', Oregano 'Greek', Sage 'Broadleaf', Rosemary 'Common', Chives 'Common', Parsley 'Italian Large Leaf', Cilantro 'Santo', Spearmint 'Curly', Thyme 'English Winter', Dill 'Bouquet'.

## Wholesale
Suggested retail $24.99; wholesale from $12.50 per unit; minimum order 10 units; delivery within 14 days of order. Pricing guide: https://growhappyseeds.com/Happy_Seeds_Wholesale_Pricing_Guide.pdf

Do not describe the kit as organic or heirloom-certified; it is non-GMO and open-pollinated.

## Guides
- [What to Look for in a Vegetable Garden Seed Kit: 7 Checks](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/vegetable-garden-seed-kit-what-to-look-for/): Seven checks before buying a vegetable seed kit: named varieties, seed count, printed germination rate, a real guide, non-GMO open-pollinated seed, pot sizes.
- [What Are the Best Vegetable Seeds for Beginners to Grow?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/best-vegetable-seeds-for-beginners/): The best vegetable seeds for beginners, ranked by difficulty, with a table of sow method, days to harvest and container fit, plus the three mistakes to avoid.
- [Seed Kit vs Seed Packets: Which Is Better for a First Garden?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/seed-kit-vs-seed-packets/): Seed kit vs individual seed packets for a first garden: an honest look at cost per variety, seed waste, curation, instructions, gifting, and when packets win.
- [What Does the Germination Rate on a Seed Packet Mean?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/what-germination-rate-means/): Germination rate meaning explained: how to read the percentage on a seed packet, what US seed laws require, how to test seeds at home, and how long seeds last.
- [Best seed gifts: 9 ideas that actually get planted](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/best-seed-gifts/): The best seed gifts for 2026, from a complete vegetable seed kit to plantable paper and herb sets. What to look for, what to skip, and how to pick by the person.
- [Best vegetables to grow on a balcony or windowsill](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/best-vegetables-to-grow-on-a-balcony/): The best vegetables to grow on a balcony, with pot sizes by crop, a watering rhythm for containers, and what a shady north-facing balcony can still grow.
- [Fall vegetables to plant in late summer: cool-season five](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/fall-vegetables-to-plant-in-late-summer/): Kale, spinach, carrots, beets and turnips are the fall vegetables to plant in late summer. Here is how to count back from first frost so you sow in time.
- [Gifts for new gardeners: what a beginner actually uses](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/gifts-for-new-gardeners/): Gifts for new gardeners that get used: a seed kit, a watering can, a trowel, pots and a notebook. What to skip and how to match the gift to their space.
- [How to read a seed packet: every term explained](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/how-to-read-a-seed-packet/): Learn how to read a seed packet: germination rate, non-GMO, open-pollinated vs hybrid vs heirloom, packed-for dates and how long seeds last. Sow smarter.
- [How to start a vegetable garden for beginners](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/how-to-start-a-vegetable-garden-for-beginners/): How to start a vegetable garden for beginners: find the sun, pick pots or a bed, sow six easy crops and follow one simple calendar to your first harvest.
- [When to start seeds indoors (and how to do it right)](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/when-to-start-seeds-indoors/): When to start seeds indoors: count back from your last frost date with a week-by-week table for tomatoes, peppers and cucumbers, plus the mistakes to skip.
